test_case.test_name: MLPerf Training v5.0 Llama2-70B official recipe and time-to-quality validation
test_case.purpose: Run the official distributed Llama2-70B Training v5.0 workload to its approved target quality and compare compliant time-to-quality with a matched result.
required_package: Official v5.0 training benchmark identifier/launcher and target-quality rule
Licensed Llama2-70B checkpoint/tokenizer/data/config and training harness/container
Checkpoint/resume/storage policy and matched MLCommons v5.0 reference
Network/GPU/power/thermal/OOM abort and distributed cleanup policy
test_case.test_command: Do not run inference-style Server/Offline arguments. After the official training recipe is supplied, validate artifacts/topology/capacity, launch all tracked workers with the approved distributed command, preserve convergence/loss/target-quality timestamps, time-to-quality, throughput, checkpoints and telemetry, stop all workers under coordinated cleanup and compare only rule-compliant training evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Training reaches the official target quality within approved limits, yields valid time-to-quality evidence, preserves checkpoints as required and leaves all nodes healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires official v5.0 training launcher, target-quality/convergence validity, complete distributed evidence and approved matched threshold. LoadGen, BERT, Server/Offline or mere error-free execution cannot pass.
safety_gate: No launch before official training recipe/quality target approval.
Validate licenses, storage capacity and all-node topology.
Abort coherently on loss divergence, OOM, network, thermal/power or worker failure.
Track all worker PIDs/jobs and checkpoint/cleanup state; no automatic restart.
expected_evidence: Matched reference comparison and coordinated cleanup health
test_case.recovery: On divergence, worker loss, OOM or invalid quality, issue the approved coordinated stop to every tracked worker, preserve last valid checkpoint and per-node logs, reconcile storage/network/GPU state across all nodes, and resume only from an owner-approved checkpoint under a new authorization.
